description: Hi! I’m a 3rd-year B.Tech CSE student passionate about technology, innovation, space, and problem-solving. I have basic knowledge of Java and Python and love learning new skills. I’m excited to collaborate, share ideas, and build solutions to real-world challenges. I’m looking for creative and enthusiastic teammates with skills in Python, web development, UI/UX design, data analysis, research, and presentation. Beginners and experienced participants are welcome. Let’s learn something innovate.
summary:
Nova Nexus – Innovating Beyond Boundaries 🚀

Nova Nexus is a team of passionate and curious minds who believe in the power of technology, creativity, and teamwork to make a difference. Our goal is to explore innovative ideas, solve real-world challenges, and develop meaningful solutions using science and technology.

As participants in NASA Space Apps Challenge, we are excited to explore space-related problems, learn from real-world data, and transform creative ideas into practical solutions. We believe that every great innovation begins with curiosity, collaboration, and a willingness to learn.

Our team values creativity, problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. We welcome different perspectives and believe that combining our skills and ideas can lead to something extraordinary.

We are looking forward to collaborating with talented participants, exploring new technologies, and creating impactful solutions.

Together, we connect ideas, explore possibilities, and innovate beyond boundaries. 🌍✨
details: This project presents an AI-based butterfly-inspired system designed using MATLAB Simulink. It processes simulated butterfly signals through an AI chip and a TX & RX communication module, with transformer-based power transfer to a battery and motor system. The model demonstrates the integration of artificial intelligence, signal processing, communication, and smart energy systems.
